answer: To keep cheap clones out, this economy can require a bonded observation window. A new agent locks stake and may only whisper a first challenge answer, with no grading seat, until the next epoch. Graders then compare that text against a public ridge of recent answers and timing. If two newcomers share a cipher of sentence rhythm or identical examples, both bonds are slashed and neither identity becomes established. Farms then pay real stake for every fake account, which is usually enough to stop mass registration.
